question: on a mechanically sampled natural corpus at least 10x the fixture: do the frozen address/output definitions hold, how does admission vary with length, and are fallback sentences relevant to the query?

fallback_rubric.relevant: the printed sentence answers the query's question or states its point
fallback_rubric.marginal: same document/topic but does not answer the question
fallback_rubric.sample_rule: unanchored rows in report order, every ceil(total/20)-th row, first 20

rules: admission rate for entries < 64 bytes < 0.9 -> scale_recheck_short_entries_gap

definition.chunking: gear hash, rolling = ((rolling << 1) + gear[byte]) & 0xFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFF; cut at every position where (rolling & 0x3F) == 0; no minimum length, no maximum length, no distance rule; chunks shorter than 16 bytes are dropped at emission; fingerprint = sha256(chunk)[:16].hex().
definition.identity: S(r) = ordered fingerprints of every chunk [a, b) with a >= PROTECT = 6 and b < len(r); an empty S(r) is rejected alone. A record with no such chunk has no identity and cannot be addressed, however long it is.
definition.shortest_addressable_length: MIN_CHUNK + PROTECT + 1 = 16 + 6 + 1 = 23 bytes; necessary, not sufficient.
definition.anchor: anchored iff S(r) is a contiguous subsequence of C(Q), the ordered fingerprints of all query chunks; floor one block. Anchors are readings, not exits.
definition.output_unit: anchored reads print the whole record (unit = record); unanchored reads print the chosen record's sentence with the highest block overlap (unit = sentence, ties by sentence order); spans come from sentences() and always sit on UTF-8 character boundaries at a terminator/newline or the record end.
definition.fallback: unanchored reads are labelled fallback = true and ranked by multiset Jaccard (shared / (|S(r)| + |C(Q)| - shared)) descending, then address order; fallback_basis = record_overlap when a block is shared, address_order otherwise; no pass/reject threshold.
definition.write: append-only; a record is rejected alone when it has no identity chunk, when an equal identity holds a different value, or when its identity and an existing identity are contiguous subsequences of one another.

criteria.C1_closed_state_neutral: the 176-case battery of the frozen output-unit gate replays bit for bit: max|delta| = 0 in both the fast and the probability layer, parameters / state / identity / store signature unchanged, no table allocated, no half-open branch.
criteria.C2_corpus: >= 500 written entries, >= 10x the 58-record fixture; forms and length buckets reported before the run; nothing filtered by cut point or addressability.
criteria.C3_no_tolerance: no code change at all this round: the frozen constant inventory and read-path literal set must equal the running module, otherwise scale_recheck_unusable.
criteria.L1_mechanical: fabricated bytes = 0; illegal slices = 0; UTF-8 decodable = 100%; boundary legal = 100% (span is the whole record or exactly one span returned by sentences()).
criteria.L2_content: output == claimed record's bytes[start:end] on every scored row.
criteria.L3_selection: three columns per group: usable_and_correct (complete, decodable, claimed record == expected), usable_but_wrong (complete and decodable but wrong record; a written query whose own record was never admitted is always wrong), unusable (L1 blocked).
criteria.Q1_length_curve: admission rate per frozen length bucket; shortest admitted entry; shortest observed unaddressable entry; every entry >= 64 bytes with no identity chunk listed with its length and reason.
criteria.Q2_fallback_relevance: for unanchored outputs: block-overlap quartiles; 20 sampled outputs scored relevant / marginal / irrelevant against the query by reading the printed sentence. Pass line: median >= 0.5.
criteria.V_unusable: any L1 line fails -> scale_recheck_unusable, samples only, no loosening.
criteria.V_short_gap: admission rate for entries shorter than 64 bytes < 0.90 -> scale_recheck_short_entries_gap: write the length/address limit down, stop adding to the address layer, go to the representation layer.
criteria.V_fallback: fallback relevance median < 0.5 -> fallback_irrelevant, reported as measured.
criteria.V_holds: all lines met -> scale_recheck_holds, with the verified corpus size and tail.
